# Locked PDF fixtures

Password-protected statement PDFs for the locked-statement tests
(`tests/locked-statement-unlock.test.mjs`,
`tests/e2e/locked-statement-import.spec.js`). Generated by
`node scripts/make-locked-pdf-fixture.mjs` (needs Ghostscript for the two image
statements; run it again only to change the fixtures).

**The fake password is `TESTCARD12345678`** (an obviously invented value, not a
real card number or ID). `OWNERONLYSECRET99` is the owner password, which only
restricts printing and copying.

| File | Content | Encryption |
|---|---|---|
| `hsbc-visa-revolution-sep-2026.locked-rc4-128.pdf` | sanitized HSBC Visa Revolution image statement (needs OCR) | RC4 128-bit, user password |
| `hsbc-visa-revolution-aug-2026.locked-rc4-40.pdf` | sanitized HSBC Visa Revolution image statement | RC4 40-bit, user password |
| `uob-one-savings-apr-2026.locked-aes-128.pdf` | sanitized UOB One savings text | AES-128, user password |
| `uob-one-savings-apr-2026.locked-rc4-128.pdf` | same text | RC4 128-bit, user password |
| `uob-one-savings-apr-2026.owner-only.pdf` | same text | owner password only: opens without a password |
| `uob-one-savings-apr-2026.plain.pdf` | same text | none (the unlocked twin the tests compare to) |

Content comes from the repo's existing sanitized fixtures
(`tests/fixtures/hsbc-ocr/image-pdf`, `tests/fixtures/pdf-statement-text`); no
real statement is involved.
